upload.title: Upload update
upload.signedOnly: Must be the signed document, not typed in by hand.
upload.hint: The update becomes a new draft version. Once you confirm it, it replaces the current one.

err.superseded: This contract has been replaced by a newer version. Open the current one.
err.draftExists: An update is already awaiting confirmation. Finish or discard it first.
err.hasVersions: Cannot delete: the contract has several versions. Only a draft update can be discarded.
err.notAllowed: Appendices have no versions. Upload the update on the main contract.
err.notLocked: The contract is not confirmed yet, so it cannot be updated.
err.generic: Could not upload the update. Please try again.

diff.title: Compare versions
diff.same: The two versions have no differences in legal fields.
